Lemma
[isometries preserve length]

↗ def:dc-ch1-2-2 ↗ def:dc-ch1-2-9

If $f:M\to N$ is an isometry and $c:I\to M$ is differentiable, then \[ \ell _a^b(f\circ c)=\ell _a^b(c) \] for every segment $[a,b]\subset I$.
Proof

\sketch The chain rule gives $\frac{d(f\circ c)}{dt}=df_{c(t)}(\frac{dc}{dt})$. Applying (1) to the velocity vector makes the two length integrands equal pointwise, so their integrals agree.

□
